impact_scope.description: S1 adds a new Thumbhash image decoder implementing the public base.image_decoder interface; no corresponding declaration or implementation exists in S0.
The new decoder exposes a caller-driven image-decoding call sequence through call_sequence states 0x00, 0x20, 0x28, 0x40, and 0x60.
S1 introduces a new Thumbhash input format requiring the three-byte magic header C3 BE FE and image-decoder input handling.

evidence: S0 has no matching Thumbhash decoder declaration or production file.
Because this format and its entry points do not exist in S0, H0 has no same-scope Thumbhash exposure or controllability obligation.

gap_after.type: missing exposure of new format and decoder protocol
evidence: S1 adds std/thumbhash/decode_thumbhash.wuffs with a public decoder implementing base.image_decoder and public decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, decode_frame, and restart_frame entry points.
H0 compiles only AUX JSON, BASE, and JSON modules and invokes JSON decoding paths; it neither enables nor instantiates the Thumbhash decoder.
H0 constructs JSON-oriented inputs and does not exercise the new Thumbhash magic header, pixel-buffer output, or image-decoder call sequence.

new_harness_obligation.description: To expose S1's new production surface, a harness must compile/enable the Thumbhash module, instantiate its decoder, construct Thumbhash input, provide image configuration and pixel-buffer arguments, and drive the image-decoder call sequence including frame decoding and, where selected, restart behavior. None of these actions was needed in S0 because the decoder and format did not exist.
evidence: The added public struct decoder implements base.image_decoder.
The added decoder consumes a caller-supplied base.io_reader and, for frame decoding, a caller-supplied pixel_buffer, blend mode, work buffer, and options.
The added call_sequence field and restart_frame function establish caller-controlled ordering and restart transitions.
H0 is exclusively a JSON token/AUX JSON harness and contains no Thumbhash module enablement, decoder construction, image buffers, or image-decoder calls.

reason: Within the stable scope of the newly introduced Thumbhash format and public image-decoder interface, no S0 obligation or gap existed because the subsystem was absent. S1 creates new callable entry points, input semantics, buffers, and a call-order protocol that unchanged H0 cannot exercise. Therefore the gap changes from false to true and is NEW.
